question: How should those who hate Kula devotees be classified?
premises: Some people hate those devoted to Kula.
Hostility to Kula practitioners reveals allegiance.
Servants of Kali are identified by such hostility.
inference: Haters of those devoted to Kula should be known as servants of Kali.
plain_english: Those who hate people devoted to Kula should be known as servants of Kali.
